title: Transfer Orbits
description: The cheapest way between two circular orbits is half an ellipse that touches both: Hohmann's transfer, one burn to leave and one to arrive. It only works when the target is where the ellipse will meet it, so the planets must stand in the right places: the transfer window, which comes round every synodic period (for Mars, every 26 months). Leave at another time and the trip costs far more: the Transfer Console's Mission Planner draws this as a porkchop plot. Unlocks the Return Beacon, which charts a route so that later trips cost nothing.

puzzle.goal: In an orbit about a body of gravitational parameter μ, the speed v at distance r on an ellipse of semi-major axis a follows from energy: v²/2 − μ/r = −μ/(2a). Write v.
puzzle.name: Vis-viva
puzzle.ask: Find v in km/s for μ = 398600 km³/s², r = @{r} km and a = @{a} km.
puzzle.method: The energy per unit mass of an orbit is −μ/(2a), whatever its shape; the kinetic part is what is left over.
